versions.name: Camp Buck Toms

features.note: High and low course elements, including a V swing.
The Dan Beard first-year camper program.
Mountain Adventure, a five-day expedition built around the mountains, rivers, caves, and trails of East Tennessee.
Includes BSA Lifeguard and a mile swim.

versions.summary: Great Smoky Mountain Council's Scouts BSA resident summer camp set on a cove of Watts Bar Lake, offering a Dan Beard first-year program, high adventure, and a wide range of merit badges.

provenance.notes: Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence). The climbing tower, COPE elements, and zip line come from the council's high-adventure page, which names them as Buck Toms facilities.
